clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Calling in the Reserves sends you south to relieve a weary sentry at the Great Lift. Maggran Earthbinder gives you a letter for Grish Longrunner, who has stood watch far from home.

Maggran Earthbinder keeps troop welfare and supplies in hand at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Across central Kalimdor, the Horde strains to keep its garrisons staffed, even in the years after the Third War. Maggran knows that endless watch duty wears seasoned soldiers down. He sends a reassignment letter south to the Great Lift, where Grish Longrunner has stood guard far from home.

The Great Lift links the high southern Barrens to the canyons of Thousand Needles. When Grish receives Maggran's letter, he can leave his lonely watch over the lift mechanisms and return to his family. Fresh reserves can take his place.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... Since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!
